cases.title: SIGSEGV in prod-checkout-api
cases.body: Segfault under load in the payment retry path. Traced to a null card token deref.

cases.title: Unhandled conversion, 37s after launch
cases.body: 64-bit float coerced into a 16-bit int. Guidance overflowed, core dumped, vehicle lost. See: Ariane 5 Flight 501, 1996.

cases.title: Stack smash in fingerd
cases.body: Unbounded gets() into a fixed buffer on the stack. Self-propagating. See: Morris Worm, 1988.

cases.title: Null dereference in session loader
cases.body: The billion-dollar mistake, invoiced again. A missing null check on an optional user.
